name: Tossed Skillet Lasagna with Zucchini, Carrot, Ricotta & Basil

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium zucchini squash
3 medium carrots
3 tomatoes
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Break lasagna noodles into thirds. Once the water in the pot is boiling, uncover, add salt and broken noodles, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Once done, drain in a colander and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 no-boil lasagna noodles
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the noodles are cooking, trim the zucchini and carrots. Run the peeler along the zucchini and carrots to make long, noodle-like strips. Place both in a large bowl.
Medium dice tomatoes; add to the bowl with the zucchini and carrot.
Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, garlic, and spices to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.

When the veggies are done, add lasagna noodles, half of the basil, and tomato sauce to the pot; stir to combine and continue to cook until heated through, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
Transfer lasagna filling to a large baking dish; top with dollops of ricotta and sprinkle with mozzarella.
Place baking dish in the oven and bake until the mozzarella is melted and golden, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide lasagna between plates or bowls and top with reserved basil. Enjoy!
